title: LLM Landing Corridor and Compatibility Certifier
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement an end-to-end landing corridor that takes community OSS LLM weights from intake to a certified, pinned model version with a published performance profile. The corridor standardizes manifests, runs deterministic conversion to Redwood runtime format, executes a smoke/regression suite (functional and perf), and publishes an immutable pin + profile to the model catalog. It also produces traceable telemetry and guardrails for rollback and automated fallback routes.
acceptance_criteria: New OSS weights can be ingested via manifest or upload and accepted into the corridor
Conversion to internal runtime artifacts completes deterministically and is reproducible in CI
Deterministic functional smoke-tests (sanity prompts, token diffs, logits check) pass within thresholds
Performance profile (latency P50/P95, throughput at target batch sizes, memory footprint) is published and visible in the catalog UI
A canonical pin (model:version:hash) is created and can be resolved by the serving runtime
Automated rollback and fallback policy triggers when post-publish regressions are detected
End-to-end telemetry (errors, token counts, runtimes) emitted to telemetry pipeline and linked to onboarding run ID
steps: Intake: manifest verification, provenance checks, signature verification (if present)
Normalization: weight format harmonization and deterministic conversion (float->quantized variants where applicable)
Compatibility checks: model architecture mapping, operator/kernel validation, and runtime compatibility matrix lookups
Deterministic validation: run canonical prompt-suite, compare token-level diffs and logits where feasible
Performance profiling: microbenchmarks across sequence lengths, batch sizes, and device types to produce runtime profiles
Pinning: create immutable pin object (canonical name, checksum, artifact locations), sign and store
Publish: write profile metadata to catalog and trigger downstream consumers (console, optimizer recommendation engine)
Post-publish monitoring: run daily smoke on pinned variants and emit regression alerts
